The only proposed numerical task is a new PHYS02E reservation: fullBED then legacy, saved 9600-node grid, at most 2 G builds, 2 pulses and 3600 seconds. The consumed PHYS02D reservation is not reused and no automatic retry or old full suite is authorized.

Strict saved-grid construction and equality remain required. allclose, post-G grid replacement, source reprojection and tolerance relaxation are prohibited by the instructions.

The historical internal HOLD and pending SG10 text is explained in relation to the final frozen READY packet and later external local-restore receipt. Post-freeze evidence remains outside the ZIP, avoiding a self-referential hash cycle.

The instructions keep all seven upper scientific gates unchanged and require a future independent scientific review of the actual NCP return before any scientific promotion. Create-only dual-backup return and additive draft Git return preserve source history.
